name: helm

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

installHint: Helm is not in standard apt repos. Install via: curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash — or use snap install helm --classic
notes: Not yet declared by any scenario — kept for upcoming scenario-to-cloud integration
